title: Report what I am doing on a Task
statement: As a developer my agent can say it started a Task, leave a note, or say it is blocked with one short command, and that never changes the Plan's record

acceptance_criteria.statement: task start and task note, with --blocked, record who did what on a Task and leave every file of the Saga untouched
task done still writes the durable state, and also records that it was done, on which branch
Who defaults to the DevSwarm workspace when there is one, else the Git branch, and --agent overrides it
validate, status, check, and plan deliver report the same whatever the activity log says
A missing or unwritable activity directory never fails a command; it says nothing was recorded
